name: Browser Use
summary: Cloud browsers and web agents for automating tasks on websites, with an open-source library.
description: Browser Use offers infrastructure for agents that operate websites. Its hosted agents complete tasks in a browser, and its cloud browsers can be driven by a developer's own agent. The project started as an open-source library. Pricing is pay-as-you-go with no subscription: cloud browsers cost $0.02 per hour, residential proxies $5 per GB, and new accounts get $1 of free credit. The company lists SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance.

howToUse.title: Open Browser Use
howToUse.description: Go to Browser Use and start for free. New accounts get $1 of free credit, and pricing is pay-as-you-go with no subscription.

howToUse.title: Run a hosted agent
howToUse.description: Run a hosted agent to complete tasks in a browser, for example forms, logins, shopping or extraction. These agents operate websites.

howToUse.title: Connect your own agent
howToUse.description: Connect a developer agent to the cloud browsers, including Playwright or Puppeteer over CDP. This infrastructure bills cloud browsers at $0.02 per hour and residential proxies at $5 per GB.
